sentences.text: Rule eighteen also covers seaplanes and wing-in-ground craft.
A seaplane on the water shall, in general, keep well clear of all vessels and avoid impeding their navigation.
But where risk of collision exists, she shall comply with the steering rules.
A wing-in-ground craft, when taking off, landing and in flight near the surface, shall keep well clear of all other vessels and avoid impeding their navigation.
When operating on the water surface, she follows the rules as a power-driven vessel.
